purpose: Add seeds 3-9 to the locked primary comparison; aggregate with protocol-matched seeds 0-2 only after completion.
schedule: 20-epoch cosine decay to 1% of initial learning rate; no early stopping
augmentation: uniform rotations by multiples of 90 degrees and horizontal flip with probability 0.5
precision: bfloat16 autocast with float32 loss; gradient norm checked for finiteness
initialization: ImageNet encoder for every model, random decoder
selection: highest complete native-grid validation mean Dice; fixed threshold 0.5
